method.action: Same finite positive-Matsubara graph action as prescribed spatial reference; raw sum, no tail
method.spectral_block: Sparse damped Newton with stationary energy descent; previous u is the next initial guess
method.fixed_boundary: Initial prescribed complex gap and independent radial spectral traces remain fixed
method.checkpoint: d and solved u/f/g are consistent; next_d is separate and never declared converged with old spectra; full fields at first sweep, every fifth, accepted, pilot end and budget end; metrics every sweep
method.stop: Core mass-weighted RMS of (d-d*)/gap_reference <= 1e-3 on free nodes r<=4ell0
method.outside_core: Report global maximum residual; the core criterion is not full-domain stationarity
method.pilot: At most two sweeps; execution measurement only, not physical admission

scope: Stationary thermal local core with prescribed winding at the boundary, not physical time
No KWT mobility, photon, circuit, kinetic populations, physical stability or activation barrier
Cutoff and mesh are compared as declared cases; no delta regularizer and no extra K0 term
No production promotion or full stage4 closure

execution.long_run_policy: User executes anything reasonably expected to exceed five minutes
execution.eta: Estimated work at the configured maximum sweeps, based on completed jobs; not a prediction of convergence
execution.resume: Explicit --resume-from with identical plan/sources/reference and a fresh output directory; hashes verified; only complete field checkpoints are indexed; at most four completed sweeps may be recomputed
execution.disk_preflight: Conservative uncompressed checkpoint projection, including first/final and header margin, must fit within 90% of available disk; pilot projection is limited to its requested sweeps
